content.name: Tomasz Nowak
content.title: Operations Manager, E-commerce Fulfilment
content.summary: Industrial engineer (B.Sc. Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen) with eight years in contract logistics and e-commerce fulfilment. Runs a 35,000 m² fashion returns and fulfilment centre with 280 employees and raised returns processing capacity by 40% in a single season.

experience.title: Operations Manager
bullets: Manage a 35,000 m² fulfilment and returns centre for three fashion brands, with 280 employees and seasonal temporary staff.
Redesigned the returns workflow into grading, refurbishment and restock cells, raising daily capacity from 25,000 to 35,000 items.
Work with the works council (Betriebsrat) on shift models, overtime rules and the introduction of new scanners.
Own a €12 million operating budget and cut cost per outbound order by 11% through better wave planning.

experience.title: Team Leader Operations (Teamleiter)
bullets: Led two outbound teams with 65 employees shipping spare parts for an automotive customer.
Kept on-time shipment at or above the contractual 99.5% for 30 consecutive months.
Rolled out daily shopfloor meetings with visual boards, which reduced picking errors by 27%.

experience.title: Logistics Planner
bullets: Planned staffing and inbound slots for a 20,000-pallet warehouse.
Built an Excel capacity model that the site used in two tender bids for new customers.
Coordinated customs paperwork with forwarders for non-EU inbound containers.

achievements.title: Returns capacity +40%
achievements.detail: Cell-based returns process at Elbkontor Fulfilment ahead of the 2023 peak.

achievements.title: 30 months at contract SLA
achievements.detail: On-time shipment at or above 99.5% at Hansa Kontraktlogistik.
